meta.name: skill-security-audit
meta.description: Audit the agent's own skill library for malicious, misconfigured, or untrusted SKILL.md files. Use when asked to review skills, audit the skill library, check for prompt injection in skills, or before adding skills from an external source.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查技能库中的恶意或错误配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要确保技能库安全无恶意代码
copy.tagline_en: Audit your skill library for malicious or misconfigured files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your skill library is safe from malicious code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会主动审计自己的技能库，检查每个 SKILL.md 文件是否包含恶意指令、配置错误或不信任的代码，并生成一份报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审查技能、审计技能库、检查提示注入，或在添加外部来源的技能前触发。建议每季度对自有库审计一次。

say.text: 审查我的技能库是否有安全问题。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整审计并输出报告。

say.text: 审计一下当前安装的所有技能。
say.note: Claude 会列出技能并标记可疑项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits its own skill library, checking each SKILL.md file for malicious, misconfigured, or untrusted content, and produces a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review skills, audit the skill library, check for prompt injection, or before adding an external skill. Recommended quarterly for own library.

say_en.text: Audit my skill library for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full audit and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Review all installed skills for potential risks.
say_en.note: Claude lists skills and flags suspicious ones.
